newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek core to be engineering, minerals.
newsitem.headline: Partek core to be engineering, minerals.

text.p: Finnish cargo handling equipment and building materials group Partek said on Wednesday a merger with state vehicle maker Sisu would make cargo handling machines and equipment, tractors and mineral-based businesses its core.
Partek also said the merger would also pave the way for its precast concrete industry to become independent.
"Our precast concrete industry can now take a step towards independence," CEO Christoffer Taxell said in a statement.
Partek said its precast concrete business was a world leader, with net sales of 1.7 billion markka and 2,400 employees.

Of the new group's total 12 billion markka annual net sales, 60 percent will come from the engineering industry, 20 percent from the mineral-based industry and 20 percent from other business operations, Partek said in a statement.
"The proportion of net sales generated abroad will be 75 percent," it said.
